markers.impact: Mucosal secretor status / gut microbial and norovirus context

FUT2 is linked to some virus-specific infection and microbiome findings; this marker cannot show infection, individual protection, H. pylori status, microbiome composition, or a digestive diagnosis.

medical assessment for persistent gut symptoms
markers.raw_dna_limitation: This is one FUT2 site.
